MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Vivaldi and Jackie Gleason’s orchestra fit the calm, instrumental listening I wanted after choosing The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe.",
    "All That Echoes feels like a natural follow-up to Stages because I want more of Josh Groban’s singing; Partners also fits my interest in polished vocal performances and duets."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The live rock collection, Blurryface Special and Skool Luv Affair do not connect with the soothing orchestral music or crossover vocals I want right now.",
    "My earlier country listening does not make A Hundred Highways an automatic fit: its spare, reflective style appeals less today than lush arrangements. Harry Chapin’s storytelling focus also misses that preference.",
    "III gives me too little information to recognize a connection to the music I have been choosing, so I would pass rather than assume it suits me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My history spans several kinds of music, but that does not mean I am equally interested in all of them during this visit.",
    "An older country choice or an interest in vocal albums seems to have been stretched too far; the particular voice, arrangement and listening mood matter to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent relaxing classical selection is a strong clue that I currently want music for unwinding.",
    "The connection between Stages and another Josh Groban album matters more to me than a broad connection between unrelated singers, and my repeated orchestral and crossover choices reinforce that preference."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in calm orchestral music and polished vocals, but treated my broader listening history as more relevant to today’s mood than it is."
}
